name: Water Whip
description:
Roll Spirit vs Dexterity against a creature within short range. On a win, they take 1d8+HEART damage. On a loss, half damage.

Either way, check a Condition.

Describe your water whip.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

✨: You may target one additional creature within range.

🌞: On each win, the creature is knocked prone.
